The workbook generation failed because expected data matrices in the 'Task' sheet were empty or contained 'None' values.
The verifier failed with AssertionError in 'test_lookup_blocks' and 'test_derived_values_and_stats'. Specifically, cells H12 through L17 (top block) and H35 through L40 (net metric) returned 'None' instead of the expected float values (e.g., H12: expected 612.5, got None). While the workbook structure was created, the logic for populating these specific lookup and derived value ranges is missing or incorrectly mapped.
